title: Wisdom & Discernment
intro: Children this age are handed more choices than they have practice with, and most of them are made in a hurry with someone watching. Wisdom is not the same as being clever, and this month we say so — it is knowing what is worth doing, being willing to ask, and being able to wait a moment before you answer.

keyScriptures.text: For the Lord gives wisdom; from his mouth come knowledge and understanding.
If any of you lacks wisdom, you should ask God, who gives generously.

weeks.title: Wisdom Is Not the Same as Clever
weeks.declaration: Being clever is knowing lots of things. Being wise is knowing what to do with them. You can grow in wisdom at any age, and it starts with wanting it.
weeks.parentsPrayer: Father, give our child a hunger for wisdom rather than for being right. Make our home a place where questions are welcome. Amen.

weeks.title: You Can Always Ask
weeks.declaration: You do not have to work everything out alone. Asking is not cheating and it is not weakness — it is one of the wisest things a person ever does.
weeks.parentsPrayer: Lord, make us the kind of parents our child comes to first. Keep our faces kind when they bring us hard questions. Amen.

weeks.title: A Moment Before You Answer
weeks.declaration: You are allowed to think before you speak. A moment of quiet has saved more friendships than any clever reply ever has.
weeks.parentsPrayer: God, slow our child down in the moments that matter. Give them the pause that keeps them out of trouble. Amen.

weeks.title: Choosing Well
weeks.declaration: Every day is made of small choices, and small choices become who you are. You are learning to choose well, and you are getting better at it.
weeks.parentsPrayer: Father, guide our child's small decisions, the ones nobody sees. Let their ordinary choices build something good. Amen.

days.title: Ask for It
days.declaration: If you do not know what to do, you can ask God for wisdom. He does not sigh or make you feel silly for asking.

scripture.text: Ask God, who gives generously to all without finding fault.

days.title: Wisdom Starts with Awe
days.declaration: Wisdom starts with knowing that God is God and you are not. That is not a small thought; it is where everything sensible begins.

scripture.text: The fear of the Lord is the beginning of wisdom.

days.title: Better Than Clever
days.declaration: Being clever gets you marks. Being wise gets you a good life. If you can only have one, choose wise.

scripture.text: Wisdom is supreme; therefore get wisdom.

days.title: Listen First
days.declaration: You will learn far more from listening than from having the best answer ready. Let people finish.

scripture.text: To answer before listening — that is folly and shame.

days.title: A Moment Before You Speak
days.declaration: You do not have to reply straight away. A short pause is not awkward; it is wise.

scripture.text: Do you see someone who speaks in haste? There is more hope for a fool.

days.title: Asking Is Not Cheating
days.declaration: Asking for help is what sensible people do. Nobody wise got there by pretending they already knew.

scripture.text: Plans fail for lack of counsel, but with many advisers they succeed.

days.title: Who You Listen To
days.declaration: Be careful whose advice you take. Not everyone who is loud is right.

scripture.text: Walk with the wise and become wise, for a companion of fools suffers harm.

days.title: Telling Good from Nearly-Good
days.declaration: Some things look right and are not. Learning the difference is a skill, and you are learning it.

scripture.text: Who by constant use have trained themselves to distinguish good from evil.

days.title: Think About the End
days.declaration: Before you start something, think about where it goes. Wise people look one step further than they need to.

scripture.text: The simple believe anything, but the prudent give thought to their steps.

days.title: Honest with Yourself
days.declaration: Wisdom starts with being honest about what you actually did, not what you meant to do.

scripture.text: You desired faithfulness even in the womb; you taught me wisdom in that secret place.

days.title: It Is Fine Not to Know
days.declaration: Saying 'I do not know' is a wise sentence. Pretending is how people get into trouble.

scripture.text: The prudent keep their knowledge to themselves.

days.title: Learning from Mistakes
days.declaration: A mistake you learn from is not wasted. The only wasted mistake is the one you refuse to look at.

scripture.text: Listen to advice and accept discipline, and at the end you will be counted among the wise.

days.title: Not Every Thought Is True
days.declaration: Not everything you think is true, and not everything you feel is a fact. You are allowed to question your own thoughts.

scripture.text: We take captive every thought to make it obedient to Christ.

days.title: Being Corrected
days.declaration: Being corrected feels bad for a minute and helps for years. People who cannot be corrected stop growing.

scripture.text: Whoever loves discipline loves knowledge.

days.title: Choose Your Words
days.declaration: Words cannot be taken back once they are out. Choose them like you would choose a gift.

scripture.text: Gracious words are a honeycomb, sweet to the soul.

days.title: Wisdom in Small Things
days.declaration: How you do small things is how you will do big ones. Practise on the little things.

scripture.text: Whoever can be trusted with very little can also be trusted with much.

days.title: Do Not Follow the Crowd
days.declaration: A crowd can be wrong together. Being the only one who stops is sometimes the wisest thing in the room.

scripture.text: Do not follow the crowd in doing wrong.

days.title: Sleep on It
days.declaration: Some decisions get much clearer by tomorrow. Waiting a night is a real strategy.

scripture.text: When you are on your beds, search your hearts and be silent.

days.title: Read and Wonder
days.declaration: Curiosity is a gift. Keep asking why, and keep reading — wisdom grows in people who stay interested.

scripture.text: The heart of the discerning acquires knowledge.

days.title: Two Sides
days.declaration: Almost every story has another side. Wait to hear it before you decide.

scripture.text: In a lawsuit the first to speak seems right, until someone comes forward and cross-examines.

days.title: Kind and Wise Together
days.declaration: Wisdom without kindness is just being sharp. The best wisdom leaves people better than it found them.

scripture.text: The wisdom from above is first pure, then peace-loving, considerate.

days.title: Doing the Boring Bit
days.declaration: A lot of wisdom is just doing the unexciting part properly. It is not glamorous and it works.

scripture.text: The plans of the diligent lead to profit.

days.title: Knowing When to Stop
days.declaration: Wise people know when to stop — talking, playing, arguing. Stopping well is a skill worth having.

scripture.text: A time to be silent and a time to speak.

days.title: Advice Worth Taking
days.declaration: Take advice from people who want good things for you, not from people who want you to be like them.

scripture.text: Blessed is the one who does not walk in step with the wicked.

days.title: Truth Even When It Costs
days.declaration: Sometimes the true answer is the harder one. Say it anyway; it costs less in the end.

scripture.text: Truthful lips endure forever.

days.title: Your Conscience
days.declaration: That feeling that something is not right is worth listening to. God gave it to you on purpose.

scripture.text: Their consciences also bearing witness.

days.title: Plans and Surprises
days.declaration: Make a plan, and hold it lightly. God is often doing something better than the plan.

scripture.text: In their hearts humans plan their course, but the Lord establishes their steps.

days.title: Wisdom Is for Now
days.declaration: Wisdom is not something you get when you are grown up. You can start using it today, in the next thing you do.

scripture.text: Do not let anyone look down on you because you are young.

days.title: Ask Again
days.declaration: If you asked for wisdom and still do not know, ask again. God does not get tired of the question.

scripture.text: Ask and it will be given to you.

days.title: Wisdom Grows
days.declaration: Nobody is born wise. It grows, a bit at a time, in people who keep asking and keep listening.

scripture.text: Jesus grew in wisdom and stature.

days.title: Wisdom Goes With You
days.declaration: Everything you have learned this month goes with you into next month, and into the next decision you make.

scripture.text: Trust in the Lord with all your heart and lean not on your own understanding.
